title: Algerian Bean Bake
description: A flavorful and nutritious Algerian-inspired bean bake with energizing and peppery notes. This recipe is perfect for a comforting dinner.

ingredients.name: Algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: Paprika, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper

ingredients.name: Bake seasoning
ingredients.notes: Paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder

instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the cooked black beans, Algerian spice blend, and diced bell pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle the bake seasoning and energizing green tea over the top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
